Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years, plus a look at the current roster (as of the 2025‑26 season):

### All‑time greats & Hall of Famers  
| Player | Years with Clippers | Highlights |
|--------|---------------------|------------|
| **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar** | 1970‑1971 (rookie year) | 10‑year career, 2× MVP, 2× NBA champion (with Lakers) |
| **David Thompson** | 1978‑1984 | 7‑time All‑Star, 2× scoring champion |
| **Moses Malone** | 1984‑1985 | 3× MVP, 2× scoring champion |
| **Michael Jordan** | 2001‑2003 (brief stint) | 6‑time champion, 5× MVP |
| **Shaquille O’Neal** | 1999‑2004 | 3× NBA champion (with Lakers), 2× scoring champion |
| **Penny Hardaway** | 1999‑2002 | 3× All‑Star, 2× All‑Defensive |
| **Chris Webber** | 2002‑2004 | 5× All‑Star, 2× All‑Defensive |
| **Derek Fisher** | 2004‑2012 | 2× NBA champion (with Lakers), 3× All‑Defensive |
| **Kawhi Leonard** | 2011‑2019 | 2× NBA champion (with Spurs & Warriors), 2× Finals MVP |
| **Paul George** | 2019‑2023 | 4× All‑Star, 2× All‑Defensive |
| **Russell Westbrook** | 2023‑present | 3× MVP, 4× All‑Star |

### Current roster (2025‑26 season)  
| Player | Position | Notes |
|--------|----------|-------|
| **Paul George** | SF | Veteran star, 4× All‑Star |
| **Russell Westbrook** | PG | Dynamic playmaker, 3× MVP |
| **Kawhi Leonard** | SF | 2× NBA champion, 2× Finals MVP |
| **Julius Randle** | PF | 2× All‑Star, 2024‑25 Defensive Player of the Year |
| **Anthony Davis** | PF/C | 2× NBA champion, 2024‑25 Defensive Player of the Year |
| **Jalen Green** | SG | 2024‑25 Rookie of the Year |
| **Cameron Johnson** | SG | 2024‑25 Sixth Man of the Year |
| **Bam Adebayo** | C | 2024‑25 Defensive Player of the Year |
| **Jamal Murray** | PG | 2024‑25 Sixth Man of the Year |
| **Other key contributors** | | (e.g., Tyler Herro, Montrezl Harrell, etc.) |

> **Note:** The Clippers have had a rich history of talent, but their most recent era has been defined by a core of superstar veterans (George, Westbrook, Leonard, Randle, Davis) complemented by emerging stars like Jalen Green and seasoned role players.
